data.name: Lights out, run
data.detailed_description:
WHEN THE LIGHTS GO OUT, IT SEES YOU

Lights Out, Run is a first-person survival horror game set inside your own home at night. What should feel familiar quickly becomes unsafe as childhood fears begin to manifest and behave like something real.

You are not just being scared. You are being watched.

Every room has different risks. Every shadow may hide something that reacts to sound, movement, or light. Survival depends on how well you can observe, adapt, and learn what each threat is before it finds you.

 SURVIVE YOUR HOME AT NIGHT

You must move through a dark, shifting house where danger is never in the same place twice.

Stay out of sight

Manage limited light sources

Listen for movement in the dark

Adapt to changing threats in real time

FEARS THAT BEHAVE DIFFERENTLY

Each childhood fear is not just a visual threat it has unique behavior patterns.

Some react to light.

Some track vulnerability.

Some only appear when you think you’re alone.

You will not survive using the same strategy twice.

LIGHT IS POWER BUT NOT INFINITE

Light helps you see what’s coming…and signals the monsters to turn them off.

Darkness exposes you… but sometimes vulnerability creates opportunities.

Every decision is a tradeoff between safety and survival.

 LEARN OR BE CAUGHT

Progress is based on understanding, not repetition.

You must:

Observe enemy behavior

Identify patterns

Use environmental cues to survive longer each night

SOME FEARS NEVER LEAVE

They just wait until the lights go out again.

data.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where you must cross your house at night while the fears of your childhood become real.
data.reviews:
“A first-person horror game set in a realistic house where you must confront inescapable childhood terrors. Navigate rooms using a flashlight and environmental objects to survive.”
Great Lake Reviews

“An upcoming psychological horror game about facing childhood fears inside a realistic house filled with monsters and hiding spots. Definitely one to keep an eye on.”
Sanctom of Horror

  • Processor: 5th generation intel processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD graphics 630
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: low profile
  • VR Support: No support
  • Additional Notes: I don't have access to various computers to determine the minimum. So I would just give it a shot if your interested since these minimum specs are just a best guess.
